rules.name: Guiding Mastery
rules.description: At the start of each friendly Player Turn, the model may choose a friendly unit within 12" consisting entirely of Beast and/or Cavalry models. The chosen unit gains Minimised (Discipline Tests) and Pack Hunter . If the unit already benefits from Pack Hunter, it gains Devastating Charge (+1″ Adv) that is only applied to Charges that are part of a Combined Charge and/or against Engaged enemy units. The effects end at the end of the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Maddening Mastery
rules.description: The model gains Terror, and enemy units in base contact with a unit containing one or more models with Maddening Mastery cannot benefit from Commanding Presence.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

The model gains Devastating Charge (+2" Adv) for Charges against units consisting entirely of models with Towering Presence.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's base size is changed to 100×150 mm and its Health Points are set to 7.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model can never issue or accept Duels or be chosen as the model that suffers the penalties for refusing a Duel.Unless mounted, the model gains Attached, Exclusive (Caiman Elders, Tegu Guards, Tegu Warriors), Stand Behind, and Strider.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

While using a mundane weapon, the model is subject to the following rules corresponding to its weapon:
  • Great Weapon: Attacks made with a Great Weapon gain +1 to wound.
  • Halberd: The model gains Distracting.
  • Tooth and Claw: The model gains +1 Attack Value.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Exclusive (Raptor Pack, Raptor Riders), and War Platform. R&F models in the model's unit gain Fearless and Frenzy. Standard Beasts and model parts with Harnessed in the model's unit gain Battle Focus.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

Units consisting entirely of models with Aerial Assault may perform a Sweeping Attack. The enemy unit suffers 2 hits with Strength 4 and Armour Penetration 0 for each model with Aerial Assault in the unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Poison Attacks.In addition, the model gains Breath Attack (Str 2, AP 3) with the following exceptions: Instead of 2D6 hits, the target suffers a number of hits equal to the number of models with Corrosive Spitter in the unit. Only a single model in each unit may use this Breath Attack once per game.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute -- Close Combat

While Engaged with one or more enemy units marked with Prey Scent, the model part gains +2 Attack Value and must reroll failed to-hit rolls with Close Combat Attacks. In addition, the model cannot benefit from Communal Bond when taking Frenzy Tests.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

While joined to a unit consisting entirely of Skink Guerillas, Skink Hunters, Skink Veterans, and/or Skink Warriors, the unit gains Feigned Flight and Vanguard.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Hand Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength, +1 Armour Penetration, and always strike at Initiative Step 0.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Once per Player Turn, at the start of 1) the Shooting Phase or 2) the Melee Phase, you may discard a Veil Token from your Veil Token pool. If so, models with Cantrips in the unit gain the corresponding effect:
  • Shooting Phase: Throwing Weapons (5+).
  • Melee Phase: Paired Weapons.
The effects last until the end of the next Charge Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Exclusive (Tegu Warriors, ) and War Platform , and loses Stubborn. In addition, the model's unit gains Cannot be Stomped .

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Enemy units do not gain any Flank or Rear Bonuses for being Engaged in the model's Flank or Rear Facing. The model never benefits from Cover.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

For the purpose of Stomp Attacks, the model ignores Cannot be Stomped and considers all enemy models without Towering Presence to be of Standard Height. If the model's Stomp Attacks are distributed onto a Large unit, the number of hits is halved, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Predator Senses and Shoot Spikes.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 12", Shots 4, Str 5, AP 2, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Special Attack

The model gains Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks). This Breath Attack is not limited to being used only once per game and can only be used once per Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 12", Shots 1, Str 4, AP 1, Marking Lure, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains +1 Armour and Minimised (Discipline Tests).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100 SI. The model gains Maximised (Stomp Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Flamethrower. Range 18", Shots 1, Str 3 {4}, AP 1 {2}, Flaming Attacks, {Multiple Wounds (D3)}. Whenever a Misfire is rolled, instead of rolling on the Misfire Table, the model suffers D3 hits that wound automatically with no saves of any kind allowed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Saurian Giant model part gains Poison Attacks. The model gains the following additional model parts:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Saurian Ancients armies do not have to contain at least one Character, and they cannot name any Character the General.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When the model's unit takes a Discipline Test, the owner may choose to apply the following rules:


  • Choose a single model in the unit to take the test for the whole unit as usual.

  • Determine the model with the highest Discipline value in any other friendly non-Fleeing unit within 8" of the unit.

  • Set the Discipline value of the model chosen in step 1 to the value determined in step 2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Right before the battle (during step 7 of the Deployment Phase Sequence), if your Army List contains one or more models with Predator Senses, you must mark a single enemy unit with Prey Scent. If a unit is marked, place a Scent Marker next to the unit. A unit is considered marked if at least one model in the unit is marked by a Scent Marker. A Character leaving a unit affected by a Scent Marker is no longer affected, unless the Character was a single model unit when it gained the Scent Marker. In that case, the Character keeps the Scent Marker. Marking a unit more than once does not offer any additional benefits.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: In the Charge Phase, units with more than half of their models with Pack Hunter may reroll failed Charge Range rolls if their Charge is part of a Combined Charge and/or if they Charge an Engaged enemy unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Ambush, Hard Target (1), and Scout.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The Champion is a Wizard Apprentice with the following additional rules:


  • The model gains +1 Health Point, up to a maximum of 3.

  • The model may select a number of spells given in the unit entry from the predetermined spells also given in the unit entry. This overrides the Spell Selection rules for Wizard Apprentices. Models that know two Learned Spells gain Channel (1).

  • If applicable, the model's base size is changed to the base size stated in brackets (X). If so, the model gains Stand Behind.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Caiman Mentors may be added to the unit. Caiman Mentors use the unit profile of the models stated in brackets (X). In addition, they follow the rules for Matching Bases (see Front Rank) and gain Fight in Extra Rank and Stand Behind.\
\
Caiman Mentors count as Characters for the purpose of distributing hits. They are not forced to choose the same Close Combat Weapons as other R&F models in the unit. Excess Health Point losses never transfer between Caiman Mentors and other Health Pools.\
\
Instead of allocating Close Combat Attacks as usual, R&F models can allocate Close Combat Attacks towards any non-Champion R&F model in a unit with Caiman Mentors, even when they are not in base contact. Attacks allocated against Caiman Mentors that are not in base contact with the attacker, including attacks from Swirling Melee but excluding Supporting Attacks that could normally be allocated towards Caiman Mentors, suffer -1 to hit.\
\
Units with Caiman Mentors cannot be joined by War Platforms.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For every unit with Marking Lure on your Army List, you must mark an additional enemy unit with Prey Scent right before the battle (during step 7 of the Deployment Phase Sequence). The number of friendly units with Marking Lure is restricted to 1 per 2000 Army Points, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Shooting Attacks with Lodestone made against a unit with more than half of its models with Armour 3 or more gain +1 to hit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Hatred against models in units that are marked with Prey Scent.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Two-Handed. The wielder gains +1 Attack Value while using this weapon. Attacks made with this weapon gain Lightning Reflexes. This weapon cannot be enchanted.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots 2, Str 2, AP 0, Poison Attacks, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots 1, Str as user, AP as user, Poison Attacks, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0-40 Models with Magnetic Short Bow per Army.

Range 18", Shots 1, Str 3, AP 1, Volley Fire, Lodestone.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: After successfully casting a Learned Spell, the model may choose to cast the Attribute Spell of Alchemy, Divination, Evocation, or Witchcraft. If so, it cannot cast the Learned Spell's Attribute Spell, if any.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model knows two additional Learned Spells that it must select from the Learned Spells 1, 2, 3, and 4 from Pyromancy, otherwise following the normal Spell Selection rules. In each Magic Phase, when the model successfully casts a spell from Pyromancy for the first time, the model's unit gains Maximised (Discipline Tests) until the start of the next friendly Magic Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains a +1 Casting Modifier.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Channel (2).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Once per friendly Magic Phase, the model may choose a single non-Hereditary Learned Spell that was successfully cast by an enemy Wizard during the preceding Magic Phase. The model knows the chosen spell until the end of the phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The first failed Dispelling Attempt during each enemy Magic Phase must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks). This Breath Attack is not limited to being used only once per game and can only be used once per Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Enemy units do not gain any Flank or Rear Bonuses for being Engaged in the model's Flank or Rear Facing. The model never benefits from Cover.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: For the purpose of Stomp Attacks, the model ignores Cannot be Stomped and considers all enemy models without Towering Presence to be of Standard Height. If the model's Stomp Attacks are distributed onto a Large unit, the number of hits is halved, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s base size is changed to 60×100 mm and it gains 6 additional Skink Riders. If applicable, Exclusive (Tegu Warriors, Tegu Guard) is replaced with Exclusive (Skink Warriors, Skink Hunters). In addition, model parts without Harnessed in the bearer’s unit gain Hatred and Poison Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model becomes the Battle Standard Bearer.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Grind Attacks (2D3) that are always resolved with Strength 4 and Armour Penetration 1. In addition, when calculating Combat Score, a side with one or more Suncatcher Crystals adds +1 to its Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly units within 8" of the model gain Aegis (5+, against Shooting Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Shooting Weapon. Range 18", Shots 2, Str 4 [5], AP 1 [3], Area Attack (1×5), Lodestone, March and Shoot, Reload!.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Spell Selection, the model must choose one of the spells below. The model can cast the chosen spell as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8):


  • Fate's Judgement (Divination)

  • Master of Earth (Druidism)

  • Molten Copper (Alchemy)

  • Swarm of Insects (Shamanism)

  • Touch of the Reaper (Evocation)


Each spell can only be chosen by a single model with Carved Wisdom.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The target suffers -1 to wound <font color='red'>⟨and gains Fortitude (5+). Models that have another instance of Fortitude gain Fortitude (+2, max. 3+) instead⟩</font>.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and Lethal Strike. In addition, attacks made with this weapon that rolled a natural ‘6’ to wound gain Multiple Wounds (2).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using this weapon, the wielder's Attack Value is set to 6 and attacks made with this weapon become Poison Attacks .

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: This weapon has Shots 4, Str 4, AP 1. If the weapon inflicts one or more hits, the Strength of all simultaneously made Shooting Attacks by the bearer's unit with Magnetic Short Bows is set to 4.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Fortitude (4+) and +1 Health Point.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's model gains Hard Target (1) and Immune (Flaming Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Rally Around the Flag . At the end of the battle, if the model has been removed as a casualty, the opponent gains an additional 200 VP.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Pack Hunter.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated when a friendly unit fails a Break Test (after any rerolls). Until the start of the next friendly Movement Phase,  enemy units within 18" of the bearer's model gain Minimised (Charge Range, Pursuit Distance, Overrun Distance).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Once per Magic Phase, the bearer may reroll a single Magic Dice when making a casting roll. This ability cannot be used if the spell was Miscast nor for Casting Attempts with only one Magic Dice.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only. May be activated at the start of any Charge Phase. Choose one friendly Large Cavalry unit or Gigantic model within 18" of the bearer's model and apply the following effects (all of them or none) until the end of the Melee Phase:


  • Each model gains Impact Hits (X), where X is equal to its amount of Stomp Attacks. If a model already had Impact Hits, increase its number of Impact Hits by its amount of Stomp Attacks instead.

  • The models cannot perform any Stomp Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Spell Selection, the model must choose one of the spells from Carved Wisdom (see Howdah Devices) that no model with Carved Wisdom chooses. The model can cast the chosen spell as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Casting Values of all spells cast by friendly models is reduced by 1.
